subject: Purchase flow blockers and proposed action plan
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Purchase flow blockers and proposed action plan

Hi Samantha — thanks for your time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and a proposed path to unblock procurement so we can get the POC started next month.

Summary of call:
- Use case: ACME wants Redwood for low-latency semantic search across customer tickets (multi-tenant PII redaction to come later).
- Pilot scope: 3 models, up to 30k tokens/day, expected trial term 4 weeks.
- Success metrics: <25ms 95th pct token latency; cost target ~$0.003/token equivalent for pilot.

Procurement gating items (what we heard):
1) Purchasing route: procurement team indicated preference for marketplace purchase but legal asked whether PO vs card is required for an enterprise contract.
2) Compliance: SOC 2 Type II report and data retention policy.
3) Contract: SOW and commercial terms; procurement wants a standard PO + net30 invoice flow, finance needs a W-9 and Redwood tax info.

Proposed action plan (short list, owners & ETA):
- Karthik: share SOW draft and pilot pricing today (attached). -- DONE (SOW_draft_v1.pdf)
- Ben: confirm PO vs card tolerance for pilot and whether we can invoice for initial run under $5k to expedite. -- Ben, can you confirm by Mon 3/2?
- Marissa: pull SOC2 report + standard security packet, share to procurement. -- Marissa, can you send by EOD Monday?

Ask for you: can you introduce the procurement contact who manages marketplace vs PO routing? If procurement insists on marketplace, we'd like to confirm listing availability and timing. If PO is required, we'll route a standard invoice and provide W-9.

Attachments: SOW_draft_v1.pdf (pilot scope & pricing)

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0182
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme-analytics.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Danny Ortiz <danny.ortiz@acme-analytics.com>, Acme Procurement <procurement@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Mar 2026 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Purchase flow blockers and proposed action plan

Karthik — thanks for the recap and the SOW. Looping in procurement (procurement@acme-analytics.com) and Danny who manages our vendor marketplace listings.

A few clarifications from our side:
- For pilots under $10k we try to use card, but our legal prefers marketplace or PO for anything that looks like an ongoing SaaS relationship.
- Procurement asked for: SOC 2 Type II (most recent), data processing addendum, and a short checklist of what we store/how long.
- Is Redwood listed in AWS Marketplace / GCP Marketplace? Danny — can you confirm if marketplace procurement is preferred for this vendor?

I've attached a short procurement checklist that our team will use to evaluate vendors (Procurement_requirements.pdf).

If we proceed with a PO route, procurement needs a vendor form filled out (tax ID, W-9). If card is OK for the pilot we can expedite onboarding.

Samantha Lee
Director, Data Platform
Acme Analytics
samantha.lee@acme-analytics.com
[Attachment: Procurement_requirements.pdf (pdf)]
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme-analytics.com>, Acme Procurement <procurement@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 11:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Purchase flow blockers and proposed action plan

Thanks for the context — quick internal answer on PO vs card and next steps we can offer to shorten the path to pilot: 

1) Card-first pilot: For pilots <= $5k we can accept card purchases via our hosted portal. This is the fastest path (minutes to enable). If Acme is comfortable, we can set the pilot cap at $4,500 to stay in that lane.

2) PO + Invoice: For PO flows we can accept a PO referencing invoice terms net30. We'll need the vendor onboarding form for Finance (W-9, tax info, address). If procurement has a standard PO template, we can accept it and will send invoice per PO terms. Typical processing time from our end is 5–7 business days after PO receipt.

3) Marketplace: We are listed on AWS Marketplace (and working on GCP). Marketplace listing can simplify procurement but timing varies based on catalog updates — Danny, if you want marketplace we can start the listing fast-track but it still may take 7–10 business days.

Action items: 
- Ben: send vendor onboarding form + W-9 to Acme procurement (doing now)
- Karthik: offer card option to Samantha for immediate unblock

I'll attach the vendor form in a follow-up.

Ben Carter
Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
[Attachment: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (pdf)]
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Acme Procurement <procurement@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Mon, 2026-03-02 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Purchase flow blockers and proposed action plan

Hi Samantha — quick weekly check-in / where-is-it-stuck note. 

Open gating items (status):
- SOC2 & security packet: Marissa to send -> IN PROGRESS (Marissa, any update?)
- Marketplace listing confirmation: Danny/Procurement -> Danny said he'll confirm ETA; pending
- PO vs Card decision: Acme to confirm. Samantha, any preference after talking with finance? If card for pilot is acceptable, we can get you started by tomorrow.
- Vendor form / W-9: Ben has sent onboarding packet to procurement; awaiting completed form from Acme.

Proposed short-term path to unblock (pick one):
A) Card-run pilot: Cap $4.5k, start immediately, procurement completes vendor onboarding in parallel.
B) PO + Invoice: Acme issues PO referencing net30; Redwood returns invoice and SOC2 + SOW; pilot begins once PO is in our system (5–7 business days).

Please reply with which path you prefer and any blockers on your side. If useful, I'm happy to jump on a 15-min call with procurement this week to speed the paperwork.

Thanks,
Karthik

Karthik — quick update from procurement: they put the vendor onboarding into the queue this morning but flagged a required SOW redline around data retention terms. They also confirmed marketplace would be preferred but the catalog ETA is ~10 business days.

Ask from procurement: can Redwood accept a one-time SOW amendment to explicitly state pilot data retention = 14 days and that no raw customer PII will be persisted? If so procurement will prioritize the vendor form.

If Redwood can accept the 14-day retention for pilot and provide SOC 2 + W-9, procurement thinks PO processing can be completed in ~5 business days after the form is returned. If not, they recommend the card route for the immediate pilot.

I'll also send a short note to Finance to accelerate the vendor form.

Samantha
